name: Fedelm, princess of Connacht

attributes.attribute: a Fedelm entry in the encyclopedia

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The index of the encyclopedia names Fedelm, princess of Connacht. The listing points to pages 181, 349, and 366. Her sister Eithne appears beside the same row. The index also carries the other Fedelm entries, the seer of Cruachan, the one of Munster, and the Nine-Times Beautiful. All these share the letter F in the index.

okr.objective: Fedelm, princess of Connacht is one of several Fedelm women in the encyclopedia.
key_results: The index lists her on pages 181, 349, and 366.
Eithne appears beside her in the index.
Other Fedelm entries include the seer of Cruachan.
The Munster and Nine-Times variants are also indexed.
